answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 638 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the echo log shows the live set and the vertex audit records each lapse. Keeping 214 aliases alive hence means 214 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the saffron quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 4 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
